record.field: Time Off by Email: Request Refused
Your time off request could not be created

div.p: We could not turn your message into a time off request.
The address you wrote from is not linked to any employee record. Please write from your work address, or ask HR to add this address to your employee file.
No date was found in your message.
The end date you gave comes before the start date.
Time off requests by email are not fully configured yet. Please contact your HR team.
Something went wrong while creating the request. Please contact your HR team.

Write the first day and the last day of your absence in the body of the message, using either the format YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2026-03-09) or the format DD/MM/YYYY (for example 09/03/2026). The first date found is the first day off, the second one is the last day off. With a single date, one day off is requested.
